statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The diagnosis codes submitted are I25.10, I34.0, R42
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
